entities.summary: Archibald Campbell, 3rd Duke of Argyll, was a British army officer, judge, politician and merchant. He was styled Lord Archibald Campbell from 1703 to 1706, and as the Earl of Ilay from 1706 until 1743, when he succeeded to the dukedom. Campbell was the dominant political leader in Scotland in his day, and was involved in many civic projects.
